# Core Nodes, supermarket drag (census #70, C15; kept as layout editing, so the bodies only).
# static/pages/nodes-supermarket.js onDrop / onDropGrid -> reparentNode / reorderLane, as served.
# Node identity travels as tile ids; success reloads the page.

-- drop SPOT-9 into lane GRP-A-L1, before its first slot
  POST /api/nodes/reparent {"node_id":9,"parent_id":2,"position":1}
  location.reload() x1
-- drop SPOT-9 into lane GRP-A-L1, after its last slot
  POST /api/nodes/reparent {"node_id":9,"parent_id":2,"position":3}
  location.reload() x1
-- drop SPOT-9 into GRP-B (the group's direct section)
  POST /api/nodes/reparent {"node_id":9,"parent_id":5,"position":0}
  location.reload() x1
-- drop GRP-A-L1-S2 within its own lane, to the front
  POST /api/nodegroup/reorder-lane {"lane_id":2,"ordered_ids":[4,3]}
  location.reload() x1
-- drop the GRP-B header onto lane GRP-A-L1
  (no request)
-- drop GRP-A-L1-S1 on the grid (out of its lane)
  POST /api/nodes/reparent {"node_id":3,"parent_id":null,"position":0}
  location.reload() x1
